changes.description: The boundary repair: a vertex that is the same point as the one before it, or the tip of a zero-width spike, is removed from a boundary as it is read, a downloaded level or a file. Neither changes the area any outline encloses. The dialog says what was removed; the evidence lists each vertex by unit, kind and position. A refusal names the unit at fault. On the standard Inspector.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently.
